title.title: Tensor saturation for the even spin groups
title.subtitle: Claim: for $\mathrm{Spin}(2n)$, an invariant that appears after scaling weights by $N$ already appears unscaled

plain: If a symmetry pattern appears after scaling everything up, it already appeared at the original size

beats.text: Saturation: if an invariant appears after scaling every weight by $N$, it appears unscaled
Knutson–Tao proved type A in 1999; in type D only Spin(8) to Spin(12) were done
The claim: every even spin group

achievement.label: Kapovich–Millson saturation conjecture, type D
achievement.context: Before: type A (Knutson–Tao, 1999); type D only for $\mathrm{Spin}(8)$, $\mathrm{Spin}(10)$, $\mathrm{Spin}(12)$
achievement.note: Type D only; types E remain

verify.detail: No Lean; a Tensor folder exists, but no main result for this family
verify.ourCheck: We read the claim and the review; we did not check the proof

voice.text: Saturation: if an invariant appears after scaling the weights by N, it appears unscaled.
Knutson and Tao proved type A in nineteen ninety-nine.
Claimed: saturation for every even spin group.

sources.quote: Spin(8) by Kapovich–Kumar–Millson (2009), Spin(10), Spin(12) by Kiers (2021)
Saturation factor 1 in type D, extending Knutson–Tao's type A theorem and the $\mathrm{Spin}(8)$ to $\mathrm{Spin}(12)$ cases. Types E remain.
